question: How many ladder faculty does Southern Connecticut State University have, and what are their average salaries by academic rank?
message:
How many ladder faculty does 130493 have, and what are their average salaries by academic rank?

**A. Tenured + tenure-track counts by rank, with salaries for all full-time instructional staff by rank**

Ladder faculty = faculty status tenured (20) plus on tenure track (30), shown as separate disjoint counts by academic rank (S2024_SIS, Fall 2024). Separate panel: average equated-9-month salary by academic rank for ALL full-time nonmedical instructional staff (SAL2024_IS, AY 2024-25), since IPEDS does not publish salary by tenure status.

IPEDS has no 'ladder faculty' category; defined here as tenured plus on-tenure-track with faculty status. Salary panel covers all full-time nonmedical instructional staff (including non-ladder, and excluding medical), not only ladder faculty; do not read it as ladder salaries. Count source is Fall 2024 (Nov 1 snapshot, degree-granting institutions); salary source is academic year 2024-25 and a different population; no cross-panel arithmetic. Tenured and tenure-track counts are shown separately; the user can add them.

**B. Comparable all-instructional-staff view (no ladder restriction)**

Both panels cover all full-time instructional staff by academic rank: counts from S2024_SIS (FACSTAT=0, all staff) and average salaries from SAL2024_IS.

Does not isolate ladder faculty; use Option A for the ladder count. Count is Fall 2024 including medical staff scope differences; salary is AY 2024-25 nonmedical only.
